# scaffold commands

Every `scaffold` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `scaffold:sync`

Propagate the installer scaffold SSoT into every downstream copy and regenerate the shipped manifest

```bash
bin/semitexa scaffold:sync
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--check` | no |

## `scaffold:sync-docs`

Mirror root AI-guidance .md files into packages/semitexa-ultimate/ (run before releasing semitexa/ultimate).

```bash
bin/semitexa scaffold:sync-docs
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--check` | no |
| `--json` | no |
